wXfPmsZW_tA.title: VRtoToon: Make Cartoons Where You Play Every Role, in VR (Free App)
wXfPmsZW_tA.description: VRtoToon is a free cartoon studio in your browser where one actor plays every role. Put on a VR headset and your head, hands and voice drive a 3D toon; then play the next character while the first one acts around you.

iIDuAWF-BzI.title: CityCrossers: The Walking Club App for Long City Walks (Free App)
iIDuAWF-BzI.description: CityCrossers is a free walking club app for people who'd rather stroll 20 km than sprint 5. Swipe on group walks near you, plan routes with café and food stops, and meet new people on foot.

FW-j_xL_DWo.title: Parapeet Is All New: Learn French Phrases in 10 Moods (Free App)
FW-j_xL_DWo.description: Parapeet, the French app that teaches every phrase in ten moods, is all new: here's the old version next to the rebuilt one.

awzVxnVHrco.title: Addanapp: приложения со скоростью ИИ под контролем опытных инженеров
awzVxnVHrco.description: Addanapp — студия разработки на заказ из Монреаля: приложения со скоростью искусственного интеллекта и под контролем опытных инженеров. Фиксированная цена, личный кабинет клиента, а платите вы только за принятую работу.

yzDUcUaH2q0.title: Addanapp: lietotnes MI ātrumā, ko apstiprina pieredzējuši inženieri
yzDUcUaH2q0.description: Addanapp ir pielāgotas programmatūras studija Monreālā: lietotnes mākslīgā intelekta ātrumā, ko apstiprina pieredzējuši inženieri. Fiksēta cena, sava darba telpa un maksa tikai par pieņemtu rezultātu.

MKOIck45xWQ.title: Addanapp : applis à la vitesse de l'IA, validées par des ingénieurs
MKOIck45xWQ.description: Addanapp est un studio de logiciels sur mesure à Montréal : des applications créées à la vitesse de l'IA, approuvées par des ingénieurs chevronnés. Prix fixe, espace client en direct, et vous ne payez que ce que vous acceptez.

-Eenu0iTZXI.title: City Fun Time: A Life-Sim Game on Your Real Streets (Free App)
-Eenu0iTZXI.description: City Fun Time is a free life-sim game on your real streets. Type any address on Earth and the neighbourhood around it becomes a 3D city, built from OpenStreetMap, with missions at real cafés, bakeries and parks. No ads, no download.

Z5MC3w_B89A.title: C-Suite Coach: Executive Training With Real Boardroom Cases (Free App)
Z5MC3w_B89A.description: C-Suite Coach is executive education and certification for current and aspiring C-suite leaders: seven programs, real boardroom cases, scenario challenges and spaced-repetition drills, with credentials anyone can verify.

RXNcbqR-jRs.title: Doremi Road: Learn Piano & Music Theory Like a Video Game (Free App)
RXNcbqR-jRs.description: Doremi Road is a free piano game that teaches music theory like a road trip: 9 territories and 42 levels across the Realm of Harmony, from your first C to the circle of fifths. Play as a guest, no account needed.

LKq6NHGjgdc.title: 40 Open Tabs? Close Them and Keep Everything | Faves Buddy (Free App)
LKq6NHGjgdc.description: Faves Buddy keeps everything you mean to come back to: open tabs, Google Maps pins, screenshots, notes and ideas, sorted for you without AI.

1T24l_1OT_k.title: Fillfox: The Free Form Builder That Shows Where People Quit (Free App)
1T24l_1OT_k.description: Fillfox is a free form builder: write a form like a document, share one link, and see every answer plus exactly where people gave up. There is no paid plan.

qWP3bxxPTWE.title: Fun To Plan: The Family Chore Board With Brownie Points & Take Turns
qWP3bxxPTWE.description: Fun To Plan is one shared board for families of 2 to 4: chores, plans and wish lists on sticky notes that look like your fridge door. Finish a task, earn brownie points, and let the points do the nagging.

DHVV7YRVxX0.title: Joining the CAF? Learn Ranks, Structure & Slang | CAF Guide (Free App)
DHVV7YRVxX0.description: CAF Guide is a free flashcard app for learning about the Canadian Armed Forces: ranks, structure, training, history, abbreviations and slang. Public reports, policies, doctrine and history, turned into cards that come back just before you would forget them.

4BjAXdLkvMY.title: Health Booker: Book Any Yoga Class in Montréal With One Account (Free App)
4BjAXdLkvMY.description: Health Booker is one account for every independent yoga studio in Montréal. Find a class, pick your mat and book, with no booking fees. Studios get a calm back office with no commission and no contract.

rgkcyhKM1T8.title: Hookline: Write LinkedIn Posts People Read Past "See More" (Free App)
rgkcyhKM1T8.description: Hookline is a free LinkedIn writing studio. Write posts in your own voice, see exactly where "see more" cuts them, and fix the hook before anyone scrolls past. No paid plan, no browser extension, and nothing posts without you.

TV4J74A9QkE.title: ImgNovella: Make Your Own Visual Novel in Your Browser (Free App)
TV4J74A9QkE.description: ImgNovella is a visual novel maker you use online: scenes, characters, branching choices and multiple endings, with no code to learn. Share your novel with a link, or package it as a game and sell it.

pGgzeKsxuk0.title: Jev Buddy: A Developer Guide to Jev, the AI Decision Model (Free App)
pGgzeKsxuk0.description: Jev Buddy is a free developer guide to Jev, TypeSafe AI's decision model: send state and typed questions, get typed answers with calibrated probabilities instead of text to parse.

lpY_f2LUTdI.title: Little Hero Books: Make a Picture Book Starring Your Child (Free App)
lpY_f2LUTdI.description: Little Hero Books makes picture books starring your child. Design a cartoon look-alike of your little one, pick a classic fairy tale, and read it on screen or print it.

tLUZzG1_Jz0.title: Logsteps: Walk a Room With Your Phone, Get a 3D Model (Free App)
tLUZzG1_Jz0.description: Logsteps turns a slow walk around a room with your phone into a 3D model you can step back into, measure, pin notes on, share with a link and edit on your computer. Free, with no app to install.

gDPcBrwAhtI.title: Mafia Camp: Play Mafia (Werewolf) on a Video Call With Friends
gDPcBrwAhtI.description: Mafia Camp is a video party game for 3 to 10 friends. Everyone joins one video call in the browser, gets a secret role and plays Mafia (Werewolf) at Camp Moonlake. No accounts.

KHZVGQ4Py7M.title: Make Your Own Clothes: Sewing Patterns Drafted to Your Body (Free App)
KHZVGQ4Py7M.description: Make Your Own Clothes drafts real sewing patterns from your own measurements, the way tailors do, sews them together in 3D on a mannequin built from your numbers, and writes you a step-by-step making book.

bTpH6t4KN2o.title: Marguru: Your Pocket Marketing Agency, With AI Prompts (Free App)
bTpH6t4KN2o.description: Marguru is your pocket marketing agency for small business owners. Describe your business in about three minutes and get a step-by-step playbook of 25 to 35 copy-ready AI prompts, filled in with your details and ordered the way an agency does the work.

7hR4RnsYm2M.title: MonShop: See What the Shops on Your Street Have Today (Free App)
7hR4RnsYm2M.description: MonShop is a live map of the independent shops, cafés and restaurants near you, with photos of what's on their shelves right now. Bookmark the places you love and get 5% off every time you go back. Free for everyone, no ads.

UuQabze-btg.title: MrBigStage: Rehearse Your Talk for a 3D Crowd That Reacts (Free App)
UuQabze-btg.description: Rehearse your next talk on a real-feeling stage: give it to a 3D crowd that reacts, with a live coach, then get one Stage Confidence score.

niJntt5oVNU.title: OScreenplay: From Half an Idea to a Formatted Screenplay (Free App)
niJntt5oVNU.description: OScreenplay is a free screenwriting studio for one writer: from half an idea to properly formatted pages. Pull a story spark, build characters who react like people, plan your scenes and write in a real screenplay editor. No AI writes for you.

3AZprKF2iH0.title: Osinty: Learn OSINT Like a Private Investigator (Free Academy App)
3AZprKF2iH0.description: Osinty is a free open-source intelligence (OSINT) academy styled like a private eye's office. Learn how investigators find answers in public information, then practise on fictional case files in a simulated search terminal. Legally, ethically, step by step.

_pmaxTfTg38.title: Who Would Play the Fae Prince? Make Your Dream Cast on PerfectCast
_pmaxTfTg38.description: PerfectCast is a free fan-casting site for romantasy readers. Pick a new release, cast its characters as a photo collage of the stars you'd choose, and watch the fandom crown its favourites. No ads.

d7Gj5GCfeOc.title: Plan Friday: Plan a Weekend Dinner Party With One Link (Free App)
d7Gj5GCfeOc.description: Plan Friday is the quickest way to throw a last-minute weekend dinner party: make a party page, send one link, and your friends say which day suits them and what they're bringing. No accounts for guests.

X7OTOzRsGy8.title: PoundFighter: Micro Workouts That Catch Monsters (Free App)
X7OTOzRsGy8.description: PoundFighter turns micro workouts into a monster-collecting game. Do a one-minute fight in bed, at your desk or standing, count your reps by voice, and capture the monster you beat.

CehQC_0r93A.title: Prepsto: Turn Customer Feedback Into User Stories (Free in Beta)
CehQC_0r93A.description: Prepsto is a customer-feedback plug-in for indie makers, product managers and small SaaS teams. Drop one link or one script tag on your site, then turn what your users say into user stories, with their own words attached.

7AX1pujnTy0.title: QuickyBricks: A Silly 3D Cube Game to Play With Your Kids (Free App)
7AX1pujnTy0.description: QuickyBricks is a silly 3D cube game for kids, played with a grown-up. Roll your squishy cube and whatever lands on top happens: BOING! TOOT-TOOT! LOVEY-DOVEY! Free, with no ads, right in the browser.

pjALr5WpIvM.title: Reelstuber: Turn One Long Video Into a Week of Reels (Free App)
pjALr5WpIvM.description: Reelstuber turns one long video into a week of short reels for Instagram Reels, TikTok and YouTube Shorts, right in your browser. Your video is never uploaded.

4KcdhVtqgNQ.title: PlanPlate: Restaurant Reservations, Floor Plan & Website in One App
4KcdhVtqgNQ.description: PlanPlate runs the front of house for restaurant owners with one restaurant or ten: bookings that confirm themselves, opening hours, a drag-and-drop floor plan, menu, specials, events, and a website made from one form.

-ZsVXlSr6tI.title: RoboIntern: Pick the Right ML Model and Get the Python (Free App)
-ZsVXlSr6tI.description: RoboIntern is a free field guide to machine-learning models for predicting from historical data, with the Python included. Paste your table's header row, and it ranks the models that fit, explains the maths, and writes the code.

2Gm5T_OHFl0.title: ArviStay: Hotel Websites That Sell the Stay, Not Just the Room
2Gm5T_OHFl0.description: ArviStay builds a beautiful Art Nouveau website for your small hotel, B&B or guesthouse from one address: it maps the neighbourhood, drafts the texts and plans each guest's stay hour by hour.

-c7CiXm_WjE.title: Robo Presence: Build a Robot and Drive It From Anywhere (Free App)
-c7CiXm_WjE.description: Robo Presence turns a Raspberry Pi, a Pi plus an Arduino, or an old phone into a camera robot on wheels that you drive live from any browser. Free: you only pay for your parts.

_Qj7nniw9cw.title: Service Request: Post Small Jobs, Neighbours Get Them Done (Free App)
_Qj7nniw9cw.description: Service Request is a neighbourhood bounty board. Post a small job (raking leaves, shovelling snow, hauling junk, moving a couch, walking a dog) from $20, and people nearby send offers. Pay cash or by Interac e-Transfer once the work checks out, with a bonus for great work.

KvFAg0fOglU.title: Sheetsmith: Turn Your Excel Workbook Into a Team Web App (Free App)
KvFAg0fOglU.description: Sheetsmith turns an Excel workbook, with its tables, formulas, validation rules, conditional colours and VBA macros, into a web app plus a tiny Python server that runs on any computer on your network. Everyone on the same Wi-Fi shares one app and the same live data.

YsGjeRjVZMY.title: Snackpuncher: Punch Fast Food in VR, a Meta Quest Workout (Free App)
YsGjeRjVZMY.description: Snackpuncher is a free VR punching quest for Meta Quest: the Greasy Horde, cartoon fast food with googly eyes, has overrun the realm of Nourra, and every battle you fight is a workout. No install, no ads, nothing to buy.

ECTqEf17FOg.title: Subsudo: Shadow-Box Anyone in the World With Your Phone (Free App)
ECTqEf17FOg.description: Subsudo is a free virtual fight club. Shadow-box one round with your phone in your fist or in front of your laptop camera, send it to anyone in the world, and let three judges decide.

arxqoGf9PlM.title: Tai Chi Please: 7-Minute Morning Tai Chi for Beginners (Free App)
arxqoGf9PlM.description: Tai Chi Please is a gentle morning practice in a bamboo forest: guided tai chi, qigong and lymphatic self-massage with a calm 3D teacher. Free, no ads, and no sign-up to try.

mfsUukKdXQY.title: Hold It, Drag It, Film It: Make Cartoons With ToonyLoony (Free App)
mfsUukKdXQY.description: ToonyLoony is a free cartoon studio in the browser for young creators and their grown-ups. Build a character, teach it moves, then press and hold it on the stage and drag it around: ToonyLoony records every step.

Eex4sJbZDNg.title: What's for Dinner? Let Mom Decide | Topameal Meal Planner (Free App)
Eex4sJbZDNg.description: Topameal is a free grocery planner for busy people and tired parents. Mom picks a week of quick one-pan toppers for the rice, pasta and potatoes you already have, and writes one shopping list. You never choose: you only say no.

Olt2yMqA_TI.title: VideoBlog Buddy: Record, Edit & Publish App Demo Videos (Free App)
Olt2yMqA_TI.description: VideoBlog Buddy is a free screen and camera recorder and video editor that runs in your browser, made for people who build apps. Record a demo, edit it, and publish it to YouTube, Shorts or Reels. Your recordings never leave your computer.

W0yKLujjtPk.title: VitalRPA: Robots That Watch Every Website You Run (Uptime & SSL)
W0yKLujjtPk.description: VitalRPA puts robots on every website you run: uptime, response time, a keyword on the page, TLS certificates, domain expiry and security headers, with no code on your sites. When something breaks, your playbooks act.

TavbKRtrFuw.title: WallTracer: Trace Any Picture Onto Your Wall With a Quest (Free App)
TavbKRtrFuw.description: WallTracer turns your headset into a projector: pick a picture, pin it to your real wall in passthrough on a Meta Quest, lock it, and trace it with a pencil. Free, with no projector and no dark room.

qv8jRRY0KG0.title: Good Landlord: Know Your Numbers, Treat Tenants Fairly (Free App)
qv8jRRY0KG0.description: Good Landlord is a free app for small landlords who want to know their numbers and treat their tenants fairly. Track rent and every claimable expense, see your cash flow and what you'd make if you sold, and give each tenant a private record of messages and repairs.

mFIuuENN_nI.title: Busy Bun: A Cosy Bao Bun Adventure in Your Browser (Free Game)
mFIuuENN_nI.description: Busy Bun is a free, cosy adventure game you play right in your browser. You're a little bao bun: run errands for the neighbours, fill your bun with meat, Steam Dash through pests and smash their nests.

Yw346NsYCr0.title: Business Buddy: Open Your Small Business in Montréal (Free App)
Yw346NsYCr0.description: Business Buddy is a free, step-by-step guide to opening a one- or two-person business in Montréal: the permits, the borough, the taxes, the real costs and the money maths, with links to the official sources. No ads.

5BWx9DjbcDs.title: Brain Mechanic: A Car-Repair-Style Manual for Your Mind (Free App)
5BWx9DjbcDs.description: Brain Mechanic is the owner's manual for your mind, written like a car repair manual. Look up what you're going through in plain words, tick the warning lights you notice, and leave with practical tools and a work order for a real professional.

X374nwXR8Qs.title: Better Than Marketplace: Sell Stuff Nearby in 30 Seconds (Free App)
X374nwXR8Qs.description: Better Than Marketplace is a free local marketplace where selling takes about 30 seconds: snap a photo with your phone, give it a name, done. No categories, no forms, no fees, no ads.

iJ6mNTshQPg.title: AutoAgile: The Agile Board for Humans and AI Coding Agents (Free App)
iJ6mNTshQPg.description: AutoAgile is an agile board for crews of humans and AI developers. AI agents pull cards, log their work and hand it in through an API, and humans approve what ships.

eoGeoGcAmg8.title: Adorable Science: Cute, Well-Sourced Science News Anyone Can Write
eoGeoGcAmg8.description: Adorable Science is fuzzy-hearted, well-sourced science news written by the community. Anyone can write an article, and a Lab Director reviews every one before it's published.

wzCMxAdyrHo.title: Addanapp: Apps Built at AI Speed, Signed Off by Senior Engineers
wzCMxAdyrHo.description: Addanapp is a Montréal software studio: apps built at AI speed, signed off by senior engineers. Fixed quotes, a live client workspace, and you only pay for results you accept.

TwZemZxbquE.title: Yabanana: Write Rap, Poems & Pop Lyrics Over Real Beats (Free App).
TwZemZxbquE.description: Yabanana is a free songwriting app for rappers, poets and pop writers. Write your lyrics over real beats, with rhymes, similes and metaphors one click away. No ads, and no AI writing your lines.

SwKfL5m7V9w.title: Office Work Automation by ARKVITAL
SwKfL5m7V9w.description: How to automate office work? Focus on Data and Clicking automation. In this video I go over some of the possible avenues you can take in learning this craft / skill.
